description: This file implements a class for transforming search requests and responses for Google Programmable Search Engine (PSE) API, including request validation, URL construction, request transformation, and response parsing.

classes.name: GooglePSESearchConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Google Programmable Search Engine API, handling request transformation, URL construction, environment validation, and response transformation.

methods.name: str ui_friendly_name()
methods.description: Returns the user-friendly name of the search engine, 'Google PSE'.

methods.name: Literal["GET","POST"] get_http_method(self)
methods.description: Returns 'GET' since Google PSE API uses GET requests.

methods.name: Dict validate_environment( self, headers: Dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Validates environment by ensuring the presence of API key and search engine ID, setting appropriate headers.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], optional_params: dict, data: Optional[Union[Dict, List[Dict]]] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Builds and returns the full URL with query parameters for making the API request.

methods.name: Dict transform_search_request( self, query: Union[str, List[str]], optional_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, search_engine_id: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Transforms a unified search request into Google PSE API-specific parameters, including handling of max results, domain filters, and country.

methods.name: SearchResponse transform_search_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw API response into a standardized SearchResponse object, mapping Google PSE items to SearchResult objects.
